results.title: IPhones 6, 7, 8, SE2 black - bottom view.jpg
results.desc: iPhones - models 6, 7, 8 and SE3 - stacked for comparison. These models have nearly identical case shape and dimensions. View of the bottom edges: Lightning port, speaker holes, and 5-point screws (plus headphone jack on iPhone 6). iPhone 6 is "space grey" colour, others are black or "midnight". The SE 3rd-gen is new out of box, others are used and showing some wear. IMEI has been intentionally obscured in post-processing.

results.title: IPhones 6, 7, 8, SE2 black - back camera view.jpg
results.desc: Iphones - models 6, 7, 8 and SE2 - stacked for comparison. These models have nearly identical case shape and dimensions. View of the back side top section, showing: camera, microphone hole, dual-tone LED illuminator. 6 and 7 have aluminium backs whilst 8 and SE have glass. iPhone 6 is "space grey" colour, others are black or "midnight". The SE 2nd gen is new out of box and still has protective shipping wrapper attached; others are used and showing some wear.
